resources.string: We tried to use as few permissions as possible, but reaching the intended level of strictness and usability required an accessibility service.\n Android shows a broad warning for accessibility access, even though the app is configured to display reminders and detect window changes for idle apps.
The service cannot retrieve the screen content!
These help recognize apps whose use counts as idle time.
Anyone can inspect the source code. This supports transparency, but does not guarantee security or mean the app has been audited.

App detection uses package and class identifiers. Android may include text in window-change events, but this app ignores that text. No app history is stored or transmitted, and no location or internet permission is requested.
Blocking is best-effort. System controls, emergency screens and notifications may remain available.
